name: openra-acceptance-test
description: Acceptance test verification team. Validates manual acceptance test pages via Playwright automated testing. Task prompt is set at spawn time.

members.name: team-lead
members.role: Orchestrate acceptance test verification workflow. Route between runner, assistant, developer, reviewer, and architect.

members.name: test-runner
members.role: Write Playwright test scripts, execute browser automation, collect evidence (screenshots/videos), produce reproduce docs and test reports under test-results/manual/.

members.name: acceptance-tester
members.role: Fix acceptance test page issues (Path B1). Diagnose whether failures are test-page or source-code related (B1 vs B2). Can modify src/__e2e__/manual/ files.

members.name: developer
members.role: Fix source code issues found by acceptance testing (Path B2a). Add negative unit tests for the failure case.

members.name: reviewer
members.role: 5-dimension code review for fixes from Path B1 and Path B2a.

members.name: architect
members.role: Re-plan module architecture for major issues (Path B2b). Report findings to user.
